presentation.label: TRACK SOLO
presentation.summary: Momentary solo: hold a track for 0.5 seconds, tap others to join, then release to restore.
presentation.overview: A session-only audition while editing. The held anchor is hidden from stock shortcuts; underlying mute and solo changes apply when the audition ends.
highlights: Hold one TRACK button for 0.5 seconds to start a temporary solo.
Toggle other audio tracks into the group with one press.
Release the anchor to return to the underlying mute and solo state.
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set TRACK SOLO to HOLD.
Hold T2 alone for 0.5 seconds, then press T3 to add or remove it.
Release T2 to end the temporary solo.

limitations: Exact package 6b7a9d2cb30ceef7d69aedd5cfe5f2ea45fdaa46f6d16069952b8ad93286a2fd on base MAIN 124548dc353b2f9cd41ba0a27113ae441e82b68a16d10a1b9509920c61839587 passed 8,693 native-routine checks, 18/18 controls, standalone/four-policy audio, and standalone/paired 52-file emulator save/reload including original-stock reload. The original scoped regression profile remains 9 passed and one fixture-inconclusive P-lock case; a separate named stock-control/exact-package P-lock edit/activation case passed. Separate Neighbor/Pickup playback passed 2/2; T8 Master passed 6/6 scoped synthetic routing/mode cases, not full gesture/audio or hardware qualification. Pickup recording/source routing, active arranger rows, remaining interactions, functional hardware, CPU/timing, total stack and full memory remain unqualified. Historical MKII RAM admission/Undo returned to the original 17-module set; it was not functional hardware qualification. Evidence is package/base-bound, not a run of the later-changed runner. See TESTING.md.
TRACK SOLO is OFF on startup and after package replacement; its enable setting and solo groups are not saved.
MIDI mode is excluded. When T8 is master, include it with the source tracks in the temporary group; T8 alone has no source audio.
Mute Modes is optional. Exact-package paired emulator audio passed for OT, OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T; the active-policy probe used synthetic mode writes. Physical Mute Modes behavior remains unqualified.
USB settings use the existing shared row table; native card settings integration is pending.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Exact ABI 8 package SHA-256 6b7a9d2cb30ceef7d69aedd5cfe5f2ea45fdaa46f6d16069952b8ad93286a2fd: 2,128-byte package, 1,500-byte linked image, zero BSS, 24 relocations, seven guarded sites. ABI 10 source probe (RUNTIME_MODULES=128; RUNTIME_POOL_BYTES=786432) estimates 2,544 bytes for one module allocation including descriptors and alignment; not an installed-base pool measurement or transition-peak bound. Writable state is inside the image. Module-owned stack subtotals and instruction envelopes are partial static accounting; total stack including stock callees/IRQ/traps and ColdFire cycles remain unmeasured. See evidence/resource-accounting.md and TESTING.md.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: No CPU/DSP-load or ColdFire cycle measurement is recorded. Partial static module-owned instruction envelopes are not cycles or a wall-time bound; stock work, cache/bus waits and IRQ/trap overhead are not bounded by them. Partial stack subtotals are not a total stack maximum. See TESTING.md and evidence/resource-accounting.md.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER > TRACK SOLO (USB runtime prototype)
steps: Install the private Track Solo runtime package in an emulator.
Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and choose HOLD for TRACK SOLO.
Close the menu, hold one TRACK button alone for 30 instrument UI ticks (about 0.5 seconds), then tap others to toggle their solo.
Release the original TRACK button to end solo; choose OFF to disable the gesture.
